name: ladder-f-txrx
about: PD4 golden boot -> ONE ordered context-create (g0 id1 key 0x64 type 1) -> ONE read-only MAC reachability read (dp_probe) -> ONE dp_setup (E1 rings/table/MAC program) -> ONE TXQ-table address sync (g0 id1 key 0x0320) -> FIRST DATA-PLANE TX: post 8-byte MSDU-info ring entries for a probe request / null-data / QoS-null frame and publish the packed producer index into the device-RAM 12-byte table entry dword1 -> read the device-consumed index back (dword2) -> ONE read-only RX capture (bounded cmp-ring poll + host-DRAM 0x28-byte descriptor scan, NO ring pointer moved) -> post packs. Host-only lane ladder F (wifi-dp-txrx, task-122), NOT yet fired at the device.

steps.name: boot-golden
steps.about: LATCHED golden handshake page + state/mask/staging before any H2D message, MAC write or data-plane frame

steps.name: catalog-boot
steps.about: D2H catalogue baseline before the H2D pair plus the data-plane frames

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: ONE context-create H2D message (g0 id1 key 0x64 type 1) - ordered precondition of dp_setup and of the TXQ-table address sync. No retry.

steps.name: dp-probe
steps.about: ONE read-only word read of MAC band-0 +0x00; no write, no retry in this boot

steps.name: dp-setup
steps.about: ONE data-plane setup (E1): BOTH the ping 0x2524 TXQ table and the 8x64x8 TX MSDU rings, tx_ba_info, the RX free/cmp rings and the 0x63c/0xb0 buffer pools are allocated; 8 device-RAM MSDU-info table entries {ring devVA,0,0} written; MAC band0 programmed with read-back. This is the same action E1 PASSes; no retry.

steps.name: pre-tx-status
steps.about: txrx bound to this load's E1 objects; no frame posted yet

steps.name: dp-txq-sync
steps.about: ONE g0 id1 key-0x0320 TXQ-table address sync (the data-plane hand-off the TX path gates on). No retry.

steps.name: tx-frame-probe-req
steps.about: FIRST DATA-PLANE TX: build a 32-B broadcast probe request (802.11 mgmt, no FCS), place it after the 16-B zero DMA header in the one coherent frame buffer, write the 8-B MSDU-info ring entry {buf_devva, ctl(len,tid=0,vap=1,hdr=1)} for user 0/TID 0 slot 0, dma_wmb, then publish packed wptr 0 -> 1 into the device-RAM 12-B table entry dword1 and read back all three dwords. One frame, no retry.

steps.name: tx-status-1
steps.about: the post landed: MSDU entry written + table wptr read back; completion_pending may be 1 (device not yet consumed) or 0 = MAC consumed the entry and wrote table dword2 (the TX completion observable)

steps.name: tx-frame-null
steps.about: second frame: 24-B broadcast null-data (data path, vap type 2) at ring slot 1

steps.name: tx-frame-qos-null
steps.about: third frame: 26-B broadcast QoS-null (vap type 2, TID 0) at ring slot 2

steps.name: tx-status-3
steps.about: all three entries are posted; completion_pending is captured as evidence (0 = device consumed all, >0 = not yet - the ladder classifies POST-ONLY, not FAIL)

steps.name: rx-poll
steps.about: ONE read-only RX observation: bounded 2000 ms poll of MAC band0 +0x4c (completion producer) then scan of the host-DRAM RX buffer pools for 0x28-byte device descriptors. Moves NO ring pointer, reposts nothing; a zero-completion window is a recorded NO-RX outcome, not a failure.

steps.name: rx-capture
steps.about: the captured evidence (MAC cmp/norm/small counters, raw completion word, descriptor + MPDU hex) is read back; 0 captures = no RX frame arrived in the window

steps.name: post-txrx-pack
steps.about: mask 0 + staging 0 after the first data-plane TX/RX session; page/state golden; mailbox drained

reads.label: mask2
reads.about: no firmware exception after the TX posts / RX capture

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: post-run D2H catalogue delta capture (the TX entries have no known D2H answer; evidence only)

steps.name: done-note
steps.about: STOP after this boot: one setup, one 0x320 frame, up to 3 TX entries and one read-only RX capture per module load. Do not retry a failed step, do not reload in the same attended session (the PD4 cave poll loop is one-shot). Recovery door armed.
